audit.why: Fizz owns level 1, the lane is a knife-edge skill duel through first item, Viktor pulls ahead at two items when teamfights punish a single-target diver. Content layer and packet chart agree; 51.14% over 4990 games with HARD/8-10 rating is consistent (hard to play, still winnable).
Spikes correct: his 6 (Chum the Waters) and first-item burst, your two-item teamfight takeover; Zhonya's called out at the right moments.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Death Ray' for Viktor E (really Hextech Ray) in spikes[0]. Full-layer chart showed Fizz on all 7 rows while the content layer and packet say rows 1-5 are Skill and 2+ items is Viktor — and phases[0].why described Viktor winning a row marked Fizz. breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers. Missing interaction: Seastone Trident auto-reset wind-up as the step-back tell was never stated.
audit.why: Kit: Fizz E 16/14/12/10/8 untargetable hop; Q 8s dash needing a 550-range target; W 7s-to-3s auto-reset; R 120/100/80. 'Land Chum the Waters' in wants.foe[1] is a suspectNames false positive — correct name, left alone.
audit.corrected: Name fixed, chart aligned with whys rewritten, cooldowns numbered, Q-target-range and W-bleed interactions written into the dos/donts bodies.

audit.why: E is 16s at rank 1 falling to 8s — the whole matchup is that timer.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Fizz wins by hopping your Gravity Field with Playful / Trickster, then cashing the shark-into-Q burst before your Q shield returns.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Gravity Field has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Playful / Trickster: 16s at rank 1, 8s at max — the untargetable hop dodges your whole combo; bait it before spending burst. - His R Chum the Waters is 120/100/80, the same clock as your storm. - Your W is 17s: while his E hop is down, the field actually sticks.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: His Q Urchin Strike needs a target within 550 — laser from behind the wave and he must dash through minions just to reach you.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: At half HP one Seastone Trident bleed plus the shark is lethal — his W is a 7s cooldown, so that window never really closes.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: He owns level 1: a mobile melee with Q resets while your shield uptime barely exists — respect it and just farm.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online evens it: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast, but his hop can void it — a duel of cooldown reads.

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: Full kit vs full kit: W zones his dash-in, his 16s E hop dodges your casts — whoever baits the other's spell wins.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: Through 4-5 it stays even: you shove with the laser, he dodges and fishes for the short Q-W all-in. Bank Manaflow.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Chum the Waters is his kill button, but Gravity Field stuns the dash and Zhonya's eats the shark — a skill test at 6.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: His first-item burst peaks but your Luden's shove-and-poke matches the tempo — play around his 120s R timer.

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Two items: teamfights punish a single-target diver — his jump eats a W stun inside your zone, and Zhonya's ends it.

edits.before: Fizz is a slippery melee, but his E (Playful/Trickster) makes him untargetable, so he can dodge your E (Death Ray) and W (Gravity Field) mid-cast if you telegraph. He'll poke with Q resets and look for a short all-in. Farm with E, keep your W as a deterrent, and don't waste cooldowns into his hop.
edits.after: Fizz is a slippery melee, but his E (Playful/Trickster) makes him untargetable, so he can dodge your E (Hextech Ray) and W (Gravity Field) mid-cast if you telegraph. He'll poke with Q resets and look for a short all-in. Farm with E, keep your W as a deterrent, and don't waste cooldowns into his hop.
